mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5% indicates accelerating inflation, triggering central bank tightening expectations that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline signal labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, rising HOUST and RSAFS indicate strong consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction effect's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% reflects labor market tightness, supporting consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the correlation with returns is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates weakening supply chain activity, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary easing cycles, a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as accommodative policy supports asset valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods within monetary easing cycles, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.
